task: Explain what a feature store is. Then summarize your explanation in one sentence.
final_answer: A feature store is a centralized data management system that stores, serves, and shares ML features through an offline store (for training) and an online store (for low-latency inference). It solves training-serving skew, enables feature reuse, and preserves point-in-time correctness. One-sentence summary: A feature store is a centralized system that serves the same feature values to training and production, eliminating training-serving skew while enabling feature reuse across teams.
